preimage_uniqueness_hypothesis.description: Theorem hypotheses derived from strict preimage uniqueness constraints.

hypotheses.statement: Theorem assumes local uniqueness is only valid under window_interior_constraint (LRC-001).
Admissible transport flux preserves equivalence families (RPF-003) but fails strict preimage uniqueness globally.
Tie-break dynamics yield locally_unique_preimage only if orientation_rank_constraint (LRC-002) is satisfied.
